blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Tropical Storm Queenie may reach typhoon category on Sunday, Sept. 27, the state weather bureau said. In its tropical cyclone bulletin, the Philippine Atmospheric, Geophysical and Astronomical Services Administration (Pagasa) said Queenie will gradually intensify while inside the Philippine area of responsibility (PAR) and become a typhoon by Sunday. As of 4 p.m. Thursday, it was located 1,205 kilometers (km) east of Northern Luzon. It entered the PAR early Thursday. READ: Cyclone east of N.
